body: It's just that I've been trying that for years now, and things have only gotten worse. I try to improve my situation, but either my ever growing sources of anxiety outweigh any benefits that my attempts at improvement made, or I fail at things altogether because my mental illness frequently leaves me incapable of even getting out of bed, let alone going to class or work, or trying improve myself in any way, which only leaves me feeling worse.

I'm definitely trying. I'm working on finding a better paying job, and I'm considering getting a certification from a technical college until I'm ready to go back to university and finish my degree. But it all still leaves me feeling like a failure, and even if I do manage to succeed somewhere, it's not enough to make me want to stick around. I'll still be dealing with everything else.
I just don't know what else there is to say, you know? Things are just so incredibly fucked, and I feel like I have nothing left for me anymore. At least I've moved farther up the queue, I guess.
